title: Newmark Pacific Arranges Lease for Manaao Thai Comfort Food at Irvine Spectrum Center
summary: Newmark Pacific announces the Company has arranged a 3,332-square-foot restaurant lease for Manaao Thai Comfort Food at 771 Spectrum Center Drive in Irvine, California.
